cause: 0.3.24 centered the disk on nominal font-size height and allowed the decoration envelope to affect row placement. Text spacing used ink widths and a disk-related gap.
solution: Measure glyph/text bounds, adapt anchor-relative versus UIKit metric convention only for the disk; preserve top-aligned text coordinates. Place the number after the weekday advance plus one common measured space. Align text independently from the disk.
weekendRule: Sunday LEFT / Saturday RIGHT, both rows share text edge at35 local units from their corresponding card side; today follows same rule. Other days centered.
weatherAdjustment: Only the horizontal space around the same weather icon is compacted: scaleVertical38 ->28. Font sizes, icons, colors and values remain unchanged. This creates safe room for the new weekend anchors while preserving font29.
limits: No optical/manual offset is added. The runtime uses Canvas measurements; UIKit measurement and SwiftUI rendering may differ slightly, as documented by Scripting.
The PNG uses synthetic data and DejaVu Mono; it is not a native SFMono/iPhone capture.
